UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and hybrid AI routing preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the dashboard header and settings.

email.description: Optional email address from Google Sign-In.

defaultInferenceMode.description: Default Firebase AI Logic hybrid inference routing mode.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on updates.

VaultItem.title: VaultItem
VaultItem.description: A note, imported document, or saved web link stored in the user's private Knowledge Vault.

content.description: Note body, extracted document text, or link annotations (up to 100,000 chars).

category.description: Primary category badge such as Ideas, Notes, Plans, Research, Links, Docs.

sourceUrl.description: Optional URL for saved web links.

fileName.description: Optional original filename for imported documents.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type for imported documents.

localFilePath.description: Optional app-private preserved original file path on device.

extractionMethod.description: Method used to extract real content (e.g., DOCX_XML, XLSX_XML, CSV_PARSER, PDF_MULTIMODAL_OCR, IMAGE_VISUAL_OCR, DIRECT_TEXT).

pageCount.description: Detected page, sheet, or section count.

sizeBytes.description: Calculated content or document byte size.

aiSummary.description: Optional AI-generated summary saved onto the item.

pinned.description: Whether this item is pinned to the top of the vault.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp set via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on updates.

DocumentAnalysis.title: DocumentAnalysis
DocumentAnalysis.description: Structured, source-grounded AI content analysis persisted per Knowledge Vault document.

summary.description: Executive summary grounded in extracted source content.

detailedExplanation.description: Detailed structured explanation of actual document content.

conclusions.description: Important conclusions grounded in the document.

extractionMethod.description: Parser or multimodal OCR method used.

extractionDisclosure.description: Explicit disclosure of extraction coverage or limitations.

mainTopics.description: Main topics and concepts identified in the document.

sourceFacts.description: Verifiable source facts with page/section references.

aiInterpretations.description: AI-derived interpretations clearly distinguished from raw source facts.

definitions.description: Key terms and explanations with citations.

entities.description: Extracted entities, dates, and figures with citations.

tableInsights.description: Insights extracted from tables, spreadsheets, or visual charts.

actionItems.description: Applicable action items with priorities and source references.

extractedPreview.description: Extracted source text preview with page/section markers.

actualSource.description: Actual Firebase AI Logic execution source reported by SDK.

AiAuditLog.title: AiAuditLog
AiAuditLog.description: Immutable privacy audit record capturing the actual Firebase AI Logic inference execution source.

promptPreview.description: Truncated summary of the user prompt or item title (1-300 chars).

actualSource.description: Actual execution environment reported by Firebase AI Logic SDK response metadata.

modelName.description: Model identifier used for execution or fallback.

transmittedToCloud.description: True only when actualSource was IN_CLOUD.

latencyMs.description: Measured end-to-end inference duration in milliseconds.

succeeded.description: Whether the inference call completed successfully.

/users/{userId}.description: User-scoped profile and default hybrid inference preferences.

/users/{userId}/vault_items/{itemId}.description: Private user-scoped Knowledge Vault notes, links, and imported documents.

/users/{userId}/document_analyses/{itemI.description: Persisted structured multimodal document analyses with source citations.

/users/{userId}/ai_logs/{logId}.description: Immutable privacy audit log of local vs. cloud Firebase AI Logic executions.
